title: Yiylotooɗo goonga tiiɗɗo
intro: E jamaanu mo majjere e dewal laamɓe fenaande ɓuuɓnata, yahdu luggiɗndu e iimanaagal feeñii. Oo neɗɗo ina luulndii noddaango renndo maɓɓe, ina ɗaɓɓa Tagɗo gooto Goonga oo e hoolaare nde ustataako. Heɓtu ngam udditde sifaa ruuhu mo ndonu mum jokki e ɓuuɓnude miliyoŋaaji.
clues: Mi naamndii ɓalli kammu, miɗo ɗaɓɓa Joomiraawo goonga tagɗo e jogorɗo fof.
Mi yamiraama yo mi yaltu leydi am, mi yaha leydi ndi Alla barkini.
Mi luulndiima sanamuuji leñol am, mi fotndi e majjere mum en to bannge ɓuuɓnude ɗum en.
Mi werlaama e yiite ɓuuɓɗo e leñol am, kono ɗum wonti cooyngal e jam wonande am e yamiroore Alla.
Mi jarribaama e yamiroore sakkitde ɓiɗɗo am gadano giɗo am, jarribo ɗooftaare timmunde.
Miin e ɓiɗɗo am, min ƴettii njuɓɓudi Galle Dewal gadano e dow Leydi, nokku ceniɗo wonande neɗɗaagal fof.
arabic: قُلْنَا يَـٰنَارُ كُونِى بَرْدًۭا وَسَلَـٰمًا عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
verse: We [i.e., Allāh] said, "O fire, be coolness and safety upon Abraham." (21:69)
